major_cooldowns.name: Eclipse
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Treat it like any other damage cooldown: press it with as much Astral Power pooled as you can without overcapping charges, and pair the window with Force of Nature or Fury of Elune whenever their timers allow.
major_cooldowns.id_note: The button is Eclipse (1239669), but every logged cast actually appears as Lunar Eclipse (1233272) or Solar Eclipse (1233346) depending on which builder was cast beforehand; both of those are the ids observed in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Alignment
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on the GCD right after Force of Nature (Keeper of the Grove) or Fury of Elune (Elune's Chosen), or once the fight will end before your companion cooldown is back up; you can hold a charge briefly for a mechanic as long as you are not already sitting on two.
major_cooldowns.id_note: The ability table lists a base_cd_s of 180s; the guide states Celestial Alignment is on a two minute (120s) recharge, so the effective cooldown is used here.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Chosen of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on the GCD right after Force of Nature (Keeper of the Grove) or Fury of Elune (Elune's Chosen), or once the fight will end before your companion cooldown is back up.

major_cooldowns.name: Fury of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Line it up on the GCD before Celestial Alignment or Incarnation, or send it on cooldown instead if you are running the Lunation talent to shrink its recharge.

major_cooldowns.name: Force of Nature
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Follow it up immediately with an Eclipse window since the treants themselves deal little direct damage; align its 60 second cooldown with Celestial Alignment or Incarnation whenever their timers overlap.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 0/5 sampled parses show a cast, but the guide covers it extensively as the Keeper of the Grove hero talent's core cooldown; verify the sampled parses were not all running Elune's Chosen before treating a zero count as a real miss.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it during your Celestial Alignment or Incarnation window once you can no longer spend your Astral Power, and press it with as little Astral Power banked as possible to avoid overcapping.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 0/5 sampled parses show a cast; the guide discusses it as a build option covered in both the opener and cooldowns sections.

rule.action: Spread Moonfire on targets while they are still being gathered, then apply Sunfire once the pull is grouped up.

rule.description: Wrath gives way to Starfire at higher target counts
rule.action: Stop entering Solar Eclipse and pressing Wrath once enough targets are up; enter Lunar Eclipse and build with Starfire instead.

rule.description: Starfire is your builder inside Lunar Eclipse
rule.action: Build with Starfire while Lunar Eclipse is active and save Wrath for your Solar windows.

rule.description: Wrath is your builder inside Solar Eclipse
rule.action: Build with Wrath while Solar Eclipse is active and save Starfire for your Lunar windows.
Only refresh Moonfire once it is in its pandemic window, or ahead of that if it would otherwise fall off during your next cooldown window.
Only refresh Sunfire once it is in its pandemic window; reapplying earlier just to be safe wastes a GCD.
Cast Starsurge to consume Starweaver's Weft before it expires.
Cast Starfall to consume Starweaver's Warp before it expires.

rule.description: Cast Convoke the Spirits at low Astral Power
rule.action: Cast Convoke the Spirits with as little Astral Power banked as possible so you don't overcap while it channels.
